title: Concentric Circle Stitch: Shapes > Rectangle/Circle/Arc > Circle, Density 3,0 line/mm
description: PE-DESIGN 11.50's Concentric Circle Stitch: circles about the centre one row (1 / density) apart; the whole circles from the largest inwards, each from one radial seam, then a trim and the circles the outline cuts, from the smallest outwards, as arcs. 4·2^n needle points a circle on the 0.1 mm grid. PE-DESIGN splits more chords inside a circle than that (2.0 / 1.0+1.0 / 1.33×3 mm runs), so counts are compared within 3 %, bounds, and the mean stitch length.

references.make: Shapes > Rectangle/Circle/Arc > Circle dragged (30,30)-(70,70) mm (a Fill region reads exactly 40,00 x 40,00); region Concentric Circle Stitch, Density 3,0 line/mm. Design Settings Hoop Size 100 x 100 mm (multi-needle machine type); line Not Sewn (Line); colour 800 EMBROIDERY RED (PEC 5); nothing else in the design. Region sew attributes of both Concentric Circle Stitch and Spiral Stitch: only Density (default 2,0 line/mm), Run pitch (default 2,0 mm) and Start Point (two buttons, default the first); no direction, under sewing or pull compensation. Defaults reset between variants. Save As PES (default type, #PES0110). Status bar 39,80 x 39,90 mm, Stitches = 2739.
